# QS-CFW-9184-50 — Quality specification - crankshaft blank CFW-9184-50 (4340)

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3  
Parts: CFW-9184-50

Scope
This document defines the quality requirements and inspection method for crankshaft blank CFW-9184-50 manufactured from 4340 material at Plant P3. It applies to all production lots of CFW-9184-50 supplied as crankshaft forging blanks.

Requirements table

| Requirement | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| Hardness range | 32-38 HRC |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.02 mm |
| Maximum forging weight | 80.8 kg |

Inspection method
Visual and dimensional inspection shall be performed on representative samples from each production lot of CFW-9184-50. Hardness shall be measured using a calibrated Rockwell hardness tester on machined reference surfaces specified in part handling instructions. Bore diameter shall be measured with calibrated bore gauge equipment capable of resolving the specified tolerance; measurement locations and methods shall ensure repeatability for CFW-9184-50. Weight shall be verified on calibrated scales and recorded for traceability for each forging blank of CFW-9184-50. All measurement equipment shall be within calibration and operators shall be trained on the measurement procedures.

Nonconformance handling
Any nonconformance of CFW-9184-50 to the specified values in the requirements table shall be segregated and tagged. The nonconforming item(s) shall be documented and controlled in the nonconformance system. Root cause analysis and containment actions shall be initiated, and disposition shall be decided by quality and production leadership. Rework or scrap decisions must ensure final condition meets the hardness range and bore diameter tolerance for CFW-9184-50 before release. Records of inspections and dispositions shall be maintained with lot documentation.
